newsitem.title: USA: Siemens unit, Toshiba reach pact.
newsitem.headline: Siemens unit, Toshiba reach pact.

text.p: The Nuclear Medicine Group of Siemens AG's Siemens Medical Systems Inc said Tuesday it agreed to supply its photon emission camera, E.CAM, Toshiba Corp on a non-exclusive basis for worldwide sales and servicing.
It said the agreement will open new sales channels, and is expected to make the nuclear medicine product lines of both companies more competitive.
Each company will continue to produce proprietary nuclear medicine cameras and computers. Financial specifics were not disclosed.

Terms provide for Siemens to supply its E.CAM variable-angle gamma to Toshiba, which will combine it with its computer-based image processor for sales under the Toshiba brand. The E-Cam is a new emission imaging system, designed for single photon emission computed tomography. It is manufactured by the Nuclear Medicine Group in Hoffman Estates, Ill.
